content:
alex_sales: Quick sync — jordan, want to confirm POC scope for your SSO/SCIM/RBAC validation. need: traffic profile, SCIM cadence, any group mapping rules, and pricing constraints from procurement.

jordan_cust: Hi — we have ~1.2k users initially, expect growth to ~4k in 6 months. Daily active ~600, peak auths ~450/min during sync windows. SCIM will be used for user + group sync. RBAC is AD groups -> product roles.

maya_se: thx. couple quick Qs: 1) are you doing full SCIM bulk import once, then delta? 2) any synchronous calls from your app at login that require SCIM lookups? 3) do you need role inheritance or custom role attributes?

jordan_cust: plan is bulk import nightly + near-realtime delta during provisioning events. yes we do a lookup on login for role membership (latency must be <50ms ideally). role model is flat groups -> roles, no inheritance.

tom_sec: security side: we'll need the security questionnaire answers (SAML config, assertion encryption, assertion consumer URL list, ACS validation). also domain controls — who will complete DNS TXT verification? any corporate entitlements that require KYC?

lisa_legal: procurement question: does Redwood store PII in the hosted product? we need DPA, SOC2 attestation copy, and encryption-at-rest + KMS details. also data residency preference (EU vs US).

maya_se: quick answers: 1) We support bulk SCIM import (CSV/SCIM bulk) and continuous delta via PATCH/PUT. 2) We can cache role lookups with a 30s TTL to meet <50ms auth path. 3) For pricing, if peak sustained throughput >300 rps we recommend a Dedicated pool; otherwise hosted usage pricing applies with burst allowances.

alex_sales: Jordan — procurement wants a cost estimate for both hosted usage and Dedicated reserved (monthly commit). I'll paste the rough numbers after we confirm peak sustained and retention.

jordan_cust: procurement prefers hosted to avoid an initial commit. can you confirm SCIM rate limits and backoff behavior? we have spike patterns when bulk imports trigger callbacks.

maya_se: SCIM guidance: bulk import endpoint for initial load (we recommend pagination of 5k per request). Delta/patch ops should be <= 200 req/min by default on hosted; we can whitelist higher tiers for the POC. server responds with 429 + Retry-After for throttling. for reliability use exponential backoff and idempotency keys.

maya_se: example patch payload we usually show to customers:
```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id}
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [{
    "op": "replace",
    "value": {
      "groups": ["engineering", "writers"]
    }
  }]
}
```

maya_se: and a curl example for delta polling (ETag-based):
```
curl -H "If-None-Match: \"<etag>\"" https://api.redwood.com/scim/v2/Users?startIndex=1&count=100
```

tom_sec: also require visibility: will you emit metrics we can scrape? need auth.success, auth.fail, scim.patch.rate, scim.bulk.latency. add logs forwarded to customer SIEM via syslog/S3?

maya_se: yes — metrics are available via the Console; for Private/Dedicated we can forward logs to your SIEM (S3, Splunk, or Datadog). hosted can integrate with S3 ingestion for exports.

lisa_legal: Jordan, I'll need a contact for your procurement team. Alex, include the DPA + SOC2 link in the quote doc.

alex_sales: noted. I'll attach links and two price scenarios: hosted (pay-as-you-go) and Dedicated w/ monthly commit + overage. also add a POC whitelist for SCIM deltas during the trial.

deploy-bot: automated check: POC sandbox environment provisioning scheduled for 2026-05-12T09:00Z. will post creds to the thread once ready. :robot_face:

jordan_cust: perfect, thanks. one last item — domain verification flow: do you support delegated domain claims (via SSO assertion) or only DNS TXT? we have multiple teams that can't add TXT records easily.

maya_se: we support both. DNS TXT is preferred for ownership proof. for enterprise customers we can accept validated SAML assertions for delegation if you provide a validated IdP descriptor + contact. we'll log delegation events.

alex_sales: next actions: (1) maya to send SCIM rate limit whitelist request form, (2) tom to share security questionnaire link, (3) lisa to confirm DPA/SOC2 links, (4) jordan to confirm procurement contact and peak sustained target. I'll follow up with a short quote and POC plan. :thumbsup:

jordan_cust: will do, thanks everyone.

maya_se: ping when you have the sample CSV export; I'll validate mapping and run a dry import in the sandbox.

tom_sec: added security checklist to thread: https://redwood.internal/docs/sec-questionnaire (pls complete and mark items N/A where appropriate).

alex_sales: closing loop — I’ll post the quote by EOD tomorrow and a POC timeline.

jordan_cust: great — looking forward to the sandbox creds.
